title: 长文本幻觉检测的健全性检查
summary: 提出一种受控不变性方法，通过Force和Remove两个测试，区分幻觉检测模型评估的是推理过程本身还是最终答案的表面特征。进一步展示TRACT轻量级评分器，基于词汇轨迹特征，在控制伪影后实现稳健检测。
summary_en: Introduces a controlled-invariance methodology with two oracle tests (Force and Remove) to distinguish whether hallucination detection evaluates reasoning or answer-level artifacts. Shows that TRACT, a lightweight lexical trajectory scorer, achieves robust detection after controlling for these artifacts.
